verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skill bundled with Python CLI tools, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it has an interactive API reference. The evidence only shows a CLI-searchable logo library, a local gallery and install instructions. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the docs-md probe returned a 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
